spans.s: श्रेण्यादी a class of words headed by the word श्रेणि, which are com- pounded with words like कृत if they stand in apposition, provided the word so compounded has got the sense of the affix च्वि i. e. having become what was not before: cf. अश्रेणयः श्रेणय: कृताः श्रेणिकृता:, एककृता: Kas, on
